summary: Matinas BioPharma filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its At-The-Market Sales Agreement with BTIG, effective July 23, 2026. The agreement, entered July 2, 2020, allowed up to $50 million in common stock sales. BTIG terminated without penalty; no shares were sold under the ATM. This is a routine contract termination filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic shift are involved. Watch for alternative financing needs but no event-driven angle.
